Opposition parties, which were united in their opposition to the Bill in April, appear to be divided now over the idea of uniform seat increase.  Some parties may support the bill if their concerns are addressed.  The Congress fears isolation and has requested an all-party meeting for discussions.  The proposed 50% seat increase aims to facilitate women's reservation without altering current proportions.
